title: Red & yellow alerts raised anew for Visayas power grid
summary: The grid will be on alert status from 3 p.m. to 8 p.m.

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Grid Corporation of the Philippines raised red and yellow alerts for the Visayas power grid on Monday, November 23.
The alerts have been issued for the following times:

items: Yellow alert: 3 p.m. to 5 p.m. 6 p.m. to 8 p.m.

blocks.text: The grid operator said that 612.5 megawatts are unavailable to the grid as 21 plants are currently on forced outage, in addition to 21 other facilities running on derated capabilities. Power imports from Mindanao, meanwhile, remain limited due to planned outages in some of the Mindanao grid's units.

A red alert status is issued when power supply is insufficient to meet consumer demand, while a yellow alert status indicates that power reserves may not be enough to meet the grid's requirement in the event of a power interruption.
